A '''nanosecond''' was an extremely small measurement of [[Time/Legends|time]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]] likened the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] to an explosion frozen nanoseconds after its eruption.
